description: Language-agnostic conformance suite. Every port (python, php, C/C++, go, javascript) must pass every case here against every backend it supports (sqlite, postgres, mysql). Each case is a sequence of operations executed in order against a single fresh connection/table; 'expect' is the exact return value of retrieve_data (null means no row found); 'expect_error' means the operation must raise/return the language's equivalent of ValidationError instead of succeeding.
